findings_not_failures.finding: radial_blur_window_cost walks every pixel of `out` (one sqrt each) before any budget check. radial_blur_window calls it first, and the byte and work budgets are applied only after the walk. With a hostile `out` (width and height up to u32::MAX, a tiny source), the call spends unbounded time before it can refuse. The other new kernels refuse first: box, axis, directional and find edges compute area x taps with checked arithmetic, and the module docs promise that bytes and work are predicted and refused before any work. Composite cannot reach this case today, because its rect is an existing layer buffer bounded by MAX_EFFECT_WORK. The public pigment API can.
findings_not_failures.repair_direction: before the per-pixel walk, refuse area x BLUR_SAMPLE_BYTES > max_bytes and area x 4 (one sample minimum) > max_work; add a hostile huge-rect refusal case to tests/ae_kernels.rs
